summary: This directory manages the analysis and metadata registration of individual source files, focusing on identifying exported symbols and maintaining file-specific context. It provides the necessary infrastructure to extract and record code information during the static analysis process.
responsibilities: Manage file-level analysis context and aggregated metrics
Locate and identify exported symbols within a source file
Register JSDoc and symbol analysis metadata
relationships: The SourceFileContext maintains the state required to locate specific symbols within a file.
Registration functions use the source file context to update analysis metadata with JSDoc and symbol details.
designDecisions: Use of interfaces to define file analysis context structures
Modular registration functions for metadata extraction
Decoupling of symbol discovery from analysis registration
